narrative.title: The Particle Beam Filter
narrative.scenario: A physics rig fires particles down a straight tube: positives travel right, negatives travel left, all at identical speed, and magnitude encodes mass. Head-on meetings destroy the lighter particle outright — equal masses annihilate both. The safety log must show which particles survive the entire sequence.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array asteroids where sign is direction and absolute value is mass.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the array of surviving particles in their original relative order.

testCases.explanation: 10 absorbs the incoming -5; the two right-movers never meet.
Equal masses annihilate on contact, leaving nothing.

hintLevels: Level 1: Only a left-mover can collide with anything — right-movers just pile up.
Level 2: Resolve the attacker in a loop: pop smaller right-movers, stop on a tie or a bigger defender.
Level 3: If the stack top is also negative (or empty), the left-mover survives without a fight.
